params.name: prevCursor
params.description: If results are paginated, this will point to the previous set of results.

params.name: nextCursor
params.description: If results are paginated, this will point to the next set of results.

params.name: createdAt
params.description: The date and time that the Transactions were created on or before, in ISO-8601 format. This is used to filter results.

params.name: stream
params.description: Indicates whether you want results from the Test and/or Live stream.

params.name: businessNumber
params.description: Indicates which business number(s) you would like to list Transactions from. You may indicate up to 5 business numbers.

params.name: transactionType
params.description: Indicates the Transaction Type(s) you would like to filter by. You may indicate up to 5 Transaction Types.

params.name: validationStatus
params.description: The one or more validation status(es) you would like to filter by.

params.name: deliveryStatus
params.description: The one or more delivery status(es) you would like to filter by.

params.name: acknowledgmentStatus
params.description: The one or more acknowledgment status(es) you would like to filter by.

params.name: senderIsaId
params.description: The Sender ISA ID(s) that you would like to list Transactions from. You may indicate up to 5 Sender ISA IDs.

params.name: receiverIsaId
params.description: The Receiver ISA ID(s) that you would like to list Transactions from. You may indicate up to 5 Receiver ISA IDs.

params.name: referenceIdentifier
params.description: Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: senderInterchangeReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Sender's Interchange Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: senderGroupReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Sender's (Functional) Group Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: senderTransactionReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Sender's Transaction Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: receiverInterchangeReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Receiver's Interchange Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: receiverGroupReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Receiver's (Functional) Group Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

params.name: receiverTransactionReferenceIdentifier
params.description: Receiver's Transaction Reference Identifier Value you would like to filter by.

Creates a Transaction using the v3 API format. Either a `message` or `summary` must be provided, but not both. For guidance on how to use this endpoint, see the Create a Transaction guide.

Creates a Transaction from a raw document. The request body should contain the raw document content (e.g. X12, XML, CSV). Routing metadata is provided via request headers rather than in the body.
